scope: Standing small masonry church of St. Mary of Blachernae and its walled garden in Ayvansaray, Istanbul, including the glazed public narthex and a simple garden bell frame.
era: Standing late Ottoman church from the nineteenth century, at the Byzantine site.

stories.title: Church of St. Mary of Blachernae

review.notes: Reviewed the exact Qualla medieval original first. Its drawing represents the predecessor. The supplemental candidate exterior has conflicting licensing and the 1877 print is an interior. The model uses the mapped geometry and firsthand exterior descriptions.
